description: Attributes served requests, service time and payload bytes using the attribution header selected above. Instrumented services contribute the matching span attribute (tenant.id, org.id or customer.id); services nobody instrumented contribute the HTTP header captured by OpenTelemetry eBPF Instrumentation (OBI). Use it to split infrastructure cost across tenants, customers or product areas.

panels.description: Share of server spans in range that carry a value for the selected attribution (${header}), from either the matching span attribute (tenant.id / org.id / customer.id) or the ${header} request header. Anything below 100% means part of the load cannot be attributed and shows up as "(unattributed)".

targets.query:
let spans = OTELTraces
| where $__timeFilter(StartTime)
| where SpanKind == "SPAN_KIND_SERVER"
| extend ServiceName = tostring(parse_json(ResourceAttributes)["service.name"])
| where $__contains(ServiceName, $service)
| extend Attrs = parse_json(TraceAttributes)
| extend HeaderRaw = Attrs["http.request.header.${header}"]
| extend FromHeader = tostring(iff(gettype(HeaderRaw) == "array", HeaderRaw[0], HeaderRaw))
| extend FromSdk = case(
    "${header}" == "x-tenant-id", tostring(Attrs["tenant.id"]),
    "${header}" == "x-org-id", tostring(coalesce(Attrs["org.id"], Attrs["organization.id"])),
    "${header}" == "x-customer-id", tostring(Attrs["customer.id"]),
    ""
  )
| extend Tenant = iff(isempty(FromSdk), FromHeader, FromSdk)
| extend Tenant = iff(isempty(Tenant), "(unattributed)", Tenant)
| extend ServiceSeconds = (EndTime - StartTime) / 1s
| extend BytesIn = coalesce(todouble(parse_json(TraceAttributes)["http.request.body.size"]), 0.0)
| extend BytesOut = coalesce(todouble(parse_json(TraceAttributes)["http.response.body.size"]), 0.0)
| extend IsError = tolower(SpanStatus) == "status_code_error";
spans
| summarize Attributed = countif(Tenant != "(unattributed)"), Total = count()
| project AttributionCoverage = iff(Total > 0, todouble(Attributed) / Total, real(null))

panels.title: Attribution coverage

panels.description: Service seconds is the summed wall clock duration of the server spans and is the most usable allocation key: it approximates the share of compute each tenant consumed. Bytes in/out come from the http.request.body.size and http.response.body.size span attributes, which only OBI instrumented services set.

targets.query:
let spans = OTELTraces
| where $__timeFilter(StartTime)
| where SpanKind == "SPAN_KIND_SERVER"
| extend ServiceName = tostring(parse_json(ResourceAttributes)["service.name"])
| where $__contains(ServiceName, $service)
| extend Attrs = parse_json(TraceAttributes)
| extend HeaderRaw = Attrs["http.request.header.${header}"]
| extend FromHeader = tostring(iff(gettype(HeaderRaw) == "array", HeaderRaw[0], HeaderRaw))
| extend FromSdk = case(
    "${header}" == "x-tenant-id", tostring(Attrs["tenant.id"]),
    "${header}" == "x-org-id", tostring(coalesce(Attrs["org.id"], Attrs["organization.id"])),
    "${header}" == "x-customer-id", tostring(Attrs["customer.id"]),
    ""
  )
| extend Tenant = iff(isempty(FromSdk), FromHeader, FromSdk)
| extend Tenant = iff(isempty(Tenant), "(unattributed)", Tenant)
| extend ServiceSeconds = (EndTime - StartTime) / 1s
| extend BytesIn = coalesce(todouble(parse_json(TraceAttributes)["http.request.body.size"]), 0.0)
| extend BytesOut = coalesce(todouble(parse_json(TraceAttributes)["http.response.body.size"]), 0.0)
| extend IsError = tolower(SpanStatus) == "status_code_error";
let totalServiceSeconds = toscalar(spans | summarize sum(ServiceSeconds));
let totalRequests = toscalar(spans | summarize count());
spans
| summarize
    Requests = count(),
    Errors = countif(IsError),
    ServiceSeconds = sum(ServiceSeconds),
    BytesIn = sum(BytesIn),
    BytesOut = sum(BytesOut)
  by Tenant
| extend RequestShare = iff(totalRequests > 0, todouble(Requests) / totalRequests, real(null))
| extend ServiceSecondsShare = iff(totalServiceSeconds > 0, ServiceSeconds / totalServiceSeconds, real(null))
| extend ErrorRatio = iff(Requests > 0, todouble(Errors) / Requests, real(null))
| project Tenant, Requests, RequestShare, ServiceSeconds, ServiceSecondsShare, BytesIn, BytesOut, Errors, ErrorRatio
| order by ServiceSeconds desc
